research_notes: Follow up financial-institution names, role-specific dates, substantive full-time status and any leave; identify the 2008–2016 electorate-office employer. Seek historical bank records only after employers are verified.

Initial avenues 2026-09-29: APH biography, 2017/2020 handbooks, first speech, ALP biography, ABC 2022 guide, banking/employer/full-time searches and public LinkedIn lead. LinkedIn direct fetch returned 429; search index did not expose usable experience. Second search engine produced irrelevant employment results. No access controls bypassed.

ABC's over-30-years description is not converted into a duration or used to extend the official 1979–2008 range. Shares, loans or family financial interests do not identify her employer. Commonwealth Bank and St George search leads remain unverified, not facts.

APH also lists ALP electorate-council secretarial and conference-delegate roles with incomplete dates; these are excluded party activity, not assumed jobs. Banking, council and staff transitions within 2008 cannot be resolved from year-only dates. Last follow-up 2026-09-29; initial record is not completion.

2026-10-01 follow-up resolved staff office through full2016 first-speech transcript and official indexed corroboration: Paul Lynch/Liverpool, not assumed employment by federal predecessors Ferguson or Hayes. Preserve2008–2016 APH dates with nine-year discrepancy. Added separately evidenced FEC presidency; no invented dates.

Avenues: full first speech, personal2023 Crean and NSW-election speeches, APH2020 handbook, ABC2016/2019/2022 biographies, two search engines for bank employers and Lynch employment, public professional-profile leads. Bank identities, individual dates, control, hours and leave remain absent. Unrelated US/UK Anne Stanley professionals rejected; mother’s BWIU employment is not Anne’s. Family/childbirth facts do not establish maternity-leave dates. No unverified Commonwealth Bank/St George attribution. Next useful evidence is historical electorate staffing/payroll and bank-specific professional records; avoid repeating exhausted generic biographies.

Westpac mentions concern constituent debanking/scams and community sponsorship, not her own employment. US financial journalism, Federal Reserve research, Toronto councillor and historical aristocrat namesakes excluded. Current financial-accountability speeches discuss regulation without a personal employer chronology. Rounded nearly30/over30-year biographies cannot resolve1979–2008 breaks. Retain bank identities, roles, hours, control and leave as unresolved, with historical bank/personnel profiles required rather than recurring generic biography searches.

No new employment fact was adopted; generic bank-name searches are now exhausted pending a historical personnel profile, archived campaign questionnaire or first-person employer disclosure.

Searches also produced unrelated namesakes and current policy discussion, which were excluded. This line is exhausted pending archived bank personnel material, an employer-specific profile or a first-person institution disclosure.
